title: ENHANCEMENT OF THE PHASE SPACE DENSITY OF LASER COOLED NEUTRAL STRONTIUM ATOMIC SYSTEMS - EXPRO PLUS
description: To develop a system enhancement in the cold atom production rate, and reduction of the thermodynamic temperature, of atomic Strontium (Sr), using novel Magneto Optical Trap (MOT) laser cooling techniques and technologies. DescriptionThe availability of an efficient and simplified system to generate a laser cooled Sr sample, in large atom numbers at low temperature, is a key driver and project enabler for both laboratory systems and field deployable systems and those for space deployment. Laser cooled atoms are an essential resource for ultra-high stability Optical Atomic Frequency Standard (OAFS) and specifically for Sr, using the quantum forbiddenelectronic transition at 698nm. These optical systems have demonstrated performance metrics (fractional frequency stability) which are orders of magnitude superior to their laser cooled RF counterparts. This opens up experimental possibilities that cannot be realised with RF systems. An Atom Interferometer, using clouds of laser cooled Sr atoms has also been proposed, and demonstrated, in a laboratory environment. Such an instrument can measure gravitational waves, in a frequency band not possible by LISA or the ground-based systems (LIGO, VIRGO etc).This activity shall serve as a development approach for both of above mentioned applications for future space implementations. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Analysis of system performance requirements and parameters leading to an OAFS and mater wave interferometry (MWI) implemented with neutral Sr - Theoretical analysis of neutral Sr atomic system and implementation of system modelling tools to explore the implementation possibilities- Develop several viable design options leading to a PDR- Trade off the design options based primarily on flux enhancement and thermodynamic temperature reduction anddesign simplification; leading to CDR - Develop manufacturing, integration and test plan to verify the performance of a breadboardunit - Roadmap the development of the Sr MOT system for specific mission scenariosProcurement Policy: C(1) = Activity restrictedto non-prime contractors (incl. SMEs). description: The specifications consist of 2 main parts: * Purchase and Installation of an injection pump Includes the purchase, piping, electrical, and automation (Siemens TIA portal) required to add an extra injection pump to our geothermal installation. title: Germany – Construction work for military buildings and installations – Ausführung Tiefbau und Außenanlagen I Mehrparteienvertrag | Aufbau Kompetenzzentrum KETTE, HIL GmbH
description: Die Bundesrepublik Deutschland beabsichtigt, am Standort St. Wendel die dort ansässigen "HIL Werke" (HIL GmbH) zum Kompetenzzentrum für Kettenfahrzeuge des Heeres (sog. "Kompetenzzentrum KETTE") umzustrukturieren. Im Kompetenzzentrum KETTE sollen zukünftig Kettenfahrzeuge der Bundeswehr gewartet und instandgesetzt werden. Hierzu werden am Standort St. Wendel neue Werks- und Betriebshallen und weitere Gebäude nebst nutzerspezifischen Anlagen - u.a. - Hauptwerkhalle für System- und Baugruppeninstandsetzung sowie Logistik und Servicebereiche (wie z. B. Warenannahme, Ersatzteillager) - Werkhalle für u.a. Turminstandsetzung - Multifunktionsgebäude für u.a. Eingangsbefundung, Ketteninstandsetzung und Ausgangsprüfung - Tankstelle - Systemwaschstraße - Schreinerei/Sattlerei - Motorenprüfstand - Halle für Unterstützungsbereiche - Verwaltungsgebäude (für administrative Arbeiten) - sowie die im Rahmen der gänzlichen Umstrukturierung des Werkareals erforderlichen Außenanlagen (inkl. zugehörige Tiefbauarbeiten und der technischen Infrastruktur) benötigt. Die Projektabwicklung erfolgt mittels der integrierten Projektabwicklung (IPA) unter Anwendung eines Mehrparteienvertrages (MPV).

title: Procedura selettiva per l’affidamento di servizi inerenti al “Programma di accelerazione europeo SPACEFOUNDERS”
description: L’Agenzia Spaziale Italiana nell’ambito dei propri compiti istituzionali e con l'intento di fornire supporto anche con strumenti innovativi alle start-up e giovani realtà imprenditoriali innovative che operano in settori collegati al campo spaziale e aerospaziale, promuove una serie di iniziative finalizzate a rendere operativo e completo un ecosistema favorevole allo sviluppo della New Space Economy nazionale, con particolare riferimento all’approntamento di adeguati strumenti di accelerazione delle start-up che permettano processi di crescita definiti scale-up. Con il presente bando l’Agenzia ha indetto una procedura selettiva aperta con negoziazione con applicazione del criterio dell’offerta economicamente più vantaggiosa individuata sulla base del miglior rapporto qualità prezzo, finalizzata all’individuazione dell’operatore per l’affidamento di servizi inerenti al “Programma di accelerazione europeo SPACEFOUNDERS”. La scadenza è stata prorogata al 16 ottobre 2023, ore 12.00 (vedere avviso in calce) Le altre scadenze sono così prorogate: Scadenza per chiarimenti: 6 ottobre 2023, ore 12.00 Scadenza per la risposta ASI per chiarimenti: 9 ottobre 2023
